entities.summary: Edward Ridley Finch Cox is an American attorney, politician, and public servant. He serves as chair of the New York Republican State Committee, having previously held that position from 2009 to 2019. Cox is married to Tricia Nixon Cox, daughter of President Richard Nixon and Pat Nixon.
